name: Numerical Analysis Computing Laboratory
description:
Programming concepts, Implementation of matrix operations and complexity in matrix operations, Numerical methods for solving nonlinear equations and system of equations, Polynomial and piecewise polynomial interpolation,
Implementation of several numerical differentiation and numerical integration algorithms, Solution of systems of linear equations: Direct methods and Iterative methods, Numerical methods for initial value problems and boundary value problems for ODEs.
